title: Mxl model data sidecar
description: The data of one model, referenced by its `data_ref` (kinetic-model.schema.json / ode-model.schema.json / steady-state-model.schema.json): named 1-D arrays such as spectra (ADR 0014). Kept out of the model file so that file stays small and diffable, as nn weights are (ADR 0008). A table is stored as one array per column; arrays sampled on a shared axis (e.g. wavelength) list that axis as an array of its own.

unit.description: Unit of every value, in the representation of the model formats' `$defs/unit` (units.json).
